meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会完整阅读项目中的每一个源代码文件，从而深入理解整个代码库的结构和逻辑。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目、接手不熟悉的代码，或说出“学习代码库”、“读取代码库”、“初始化”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请学习这个代码库，告诉我它的整体架构。
say.note: Claude 会开始逐文件阅读并总结。

say.text: 读取代码库，然后帮我理解主要模块。
say.note: Claude 会阅读所有源文件并给出模块说明。

howto.what_en: Claude will read every source file in the project to build a deep understanding of the codebase structure and logic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, working on unfamiliar code, or when the user says "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", etc.

say_en.text: Please learn this codebase and tell me its overall architecture.
say_en.note: Claude will start reading files and summarize.

say_en.text: Read the codebase and help me understand the main modules.
say_en.note: Claude will read all source files and explain modules.
